assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: The transport context screen uses an OpenStreetMap Overpass snapshot accessed on 2026-08-08, clipped against the provisional submission boundary and an 800 m analytical buffer.
assumptions.impact: Mapped station names, crossings and line densities indicate where field audits should start, but they do not establish official station entrances, road classification, capacity, right-of-way, accessibility quality or statutory controls.

assumptions.statement: The repository's 2026-08-08 OSM cross-check records that the mapped built Jing-Zhang Railway Heritage Park did not intersect the current provisional overall-design polygon (0.00 ha / 0%; nearest distance 412.5 m), while the broader research polygon covered the mapped park. OSM may be incomplete and neither geometry is official.
assumptions.impact: Do not shift the submitted boundary or treat OSM as a formal source. Keep park, transport and area interpretations provisional, disclose the discrepancy, and replace all affected layers and metrics together when the organizer supplies official polygons.

assumptions.statement: Resident satisfaction, night-time comfort, perceived safety, noise, crowding and service access currently lack a project-specific baseline survey.
assumptions.impact: Resident-experience targets are evaluation gates for reversible pilots, not claims about current conditions or guaranteed future performance.

assumptions.statement: Peak-hour passenger demand, intersection delay, parking occupancy, freight/service access and event-day traffic management data are not available for the full design area.
assumptions.impact: No new interchange, bridge, tunnel, road widening, parking supply or signal plan is committed; each requires traffic modelling, field counts, safety audit and approval.

assumptions.statement: The resilience experiment uses eight explicit design stresses—heatwave, cloudburst, drought, network outage, tripled robot fleet, event crowd surge, reduced maintenance capacity and winter freeze-thaw—because no site-specific downscaled climate or operations series is included in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Stress increments such as +2 C heat and +20% cloudburst intensity are sensitivity tests, not Beijing forecasts. Official climate, hydraulic, operations and emergency data must replace the proxies before engineering design.

assumptions.statement: Airflow, pollutant dispersion, shade and thermal comfort are screened through spatial design rules only; no CFD model, anemometer array, PM2.5 time series or mean radiant temperature survey is available. The phrases 藏风聚气 and 风水 are retained only as cultural landscape narratives, not as health, air-quality or engineering causation.
assumptions.impact: Translate the narrative into separately testable pedestrian wind comfort, pollutant stagnation/dilution, heat exposure and shade indicators. Keep open-air corridors, avoid solid wind-blocking screens and test three key areas with seasonal CFD and field measurements before fixing tree, canopy or building interventions.

assumptions.statement: No verified elevation model, pipe diameter/capacity, outfall, soil infiltration, groundwater, pollution or flood-depth dataset is available for the provisional site.
assumptions.impact: Rain gardens, blue-green links, storage and exceedance paths are design targets; no health benefit, infiltration volume, pipe upgrade or flood-free claim is made. A catchment model, water-quality baseline and maintenance plan are mandatory before construction.

assumptions.statement: Embodied-AI scenarios assume low-speed, geofenced, human-supervised tests for delivery, mobility assistance and inspection robots; no autonomous public deployment or vendor is assumed.
assumptions.impact: Every test must preserve a continuous accessible human route, provide remote stop and incident logging, publish operating windows and pass safety, privacy and insurance review before public use.

assumptions.statement: The package does not contain asset owners, service-level agreements, maintenance budgets, replacement cycles or procurement contracts.
assumptions.impact: The selected scenario is a maintenance-ready design pattern with asset IDs, inspection triggers and failure rollback; it is not a funded operations commitment.

assumptions.statement: Human-experience scores are design-rubric targets pending stratified resident, worker, student, visitor, older-adult and disabled-person testing across seasons and time periods.
assumptions.impact: The project may advance only when measured accessibility, perceived safety, heat comfort, quietness, service access and trust meet the gates; a high simulation score cannot override lived-experience evidence.

assumptions.statement: Five normalized design archetypes are compared across eleven criteria, five stakeholder profiles and eight stress scenarios using 50000 deterministic Monte Carlo draws with seed 147228.
assumptions.impact: The result identifies a low-regret concept for further testing. It is not CFD, SWMM, traffic, acoustic, energy, structural, robot-certification, cost or post-occupancy evidence, and it must be recalibrated when measured inputs arrive.

assumptions.statement: Beijing's public data platform lists a 1991-2020 Haidian surface-climate normals dataset, but the downloadable file requires a platform user key and is not included in the repository.
assumptions.impact: The submission cites the dataset as a required calibration source but does not quote unavailable temperature, precipitation, wind or humidity values. Seasonal wind and thermal claims remain pending.

assumptions.statement: No site-specific bird, insect, vegetation, soil, water-quality, glass-collision or night-light baseline is available for the provisional corridor.
assumptions.impact: Native planting, habitat stepping stones, dark-sky zones and bird-safe interfaces are design directions only; ecological surveys and lighting review must precede detailed design.

assumptions.statement: Resident continuity, small-merchant return, night service, manual-channel availability and screen-free rest are design requirements with unknown project-level baselines.
assumptions.impact: The human-first buffer cannot claim anti-displacement, service, health or inclusion outcomes. A compensated, accessible and opt-out participation panel must define denominators and follow-up before any indicator is upgraded from unknown.

assumptions.statement: IMF exposure estimates and WEF surveyed-employer expectations are global or survey-context evidence for why a skills-retraining corridor deserves a spatial interface; they do not estimate Haidian job loss, worker count, placement or training demand.
assumptions.impact: Use the sources to justify a reversible public service and human appeal route only. Do not write local employment, displacement or reskilling performance claims without a local cohort and consent.

assumptions.statement: Beijing data-center energy rules and waste-heat policy establish a policy gate, not evidence that the provisional Jing-Zhang corridor contains an eligible data center, heat source, green-electricity contract, network interface or operator.
assumptions.impact: PUE, green-electricity, metering and heat-handoff indicators remain unknown. The city API contract may describe required fields and stop conditions but cannot authorize a facility, infer capacity or claim savings.

assumptions.statement: The minimum API fields, release notes, annual review and rollback loop are a conceptual governance interface; no municipal API, asset registry, low-altitude route, embodied-AI permit or public test has been run.
assumptions.impact: Any machine-readable scenario stays not_authorized_not_run until responsible roles, human fallback, privacy, safety, insurance, public objection and professional review are documented.
